camel_example: aliyun esa UpgradeEnvironmentVersion --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 12456780000 --EnvironmentName '默认环境'
description_en: Upgrades the deployment version of an environment
kebab_example: aliyun esa upgrade-environment-version --site-id 12456780000 --environment-name '默认环境' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeEnvironmentVersion

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The environment name. The version of this environment is upgraded and deployed to the environment with the next priority level
parameters.help_zh: 环境名称，把该环境的版本升级部署到【下一个优先级】的环境中
parameters.name: environment_name
